levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب
عبد الله بن عامر بن سعد الأشعري

notes: «حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي» is the compiler's own father, a bare relation; «جميعاً» marks the three names of the second level, whose routes meet at the third.
The Imam is written after «عن» inside the chain, so he is a narrator; «سمعته يقول» makes his words the saying.
